title: About Me
text:
Hi there! I’m Ben, a current accelerated masters student in the Molecular and Cellular Biotechnology program at the University of New Hampshire. I recently graduated summa cum laude with my Bachelors of Science in Biochemistry, Molecular, and Cellular Biology.


Do something great that both fulfills me and contributes to society.



Masters of Science - Molecular and Cellular Biotechnology - University of New Hampshire
Bachelors of Science - Biochemistry, Molecular, and Cellular Biology - University of New Hampshire
High School Diploma - Salem High School - Salem, NH



Undergraduate Research Assistant - Department of Chemical Engineering and Bioengineering - University of New Hampshire
Advisor: Dr. Linqing Li
Project: Engineered Biocomposites for Angiogenic Signaling and Tissue Vascularization
• Characterized how biophysical properties of Collagen I & DexMA composites influence HUVEC & HDF spreading & migration
• Identified material formulations that promote coordinated, group cell translocation, & in situ vasculature formation in co-culture
• Established design principles linking scaffold composition to vasculogenic outcome, laying groundwork for future paracrine signaling studies and organoid applications
•Best League of Legends player of all time #Masonistrash
Thanks for checking out my website!
